mapper.select: SELECT i.TAX_INPUT_ID AS taxInputId, i.TAX_YEAR AS taxYear, r.CALCULATED_AT AS savedAt, CAST(r.RESULT_DETAIL->>'$.breakdown.totalIncome' AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS totalIncome, CAST(r.RESULT_DETAIL->>'$.breakdown.totalExpense' AS DECIMAL(15,2)) AS totalExpense, CAST(r.RESULT_DETAIL->>'$.breakdown.totalTax' AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS totalTax FROM tax_inputs i JOIN tax_results r ON r.TAX_INPUT_ID = i.TAX_INPUT_ID WHERE i.USER_ID = #{userId} AND i.SAVE_STATUS = 'SAVED' ORDER BY i.TAX_YEAR DESC, r.CALCULATED_AT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SIMULATION (USER_ID, TAX_INPUT_ID, TITLE, INPUT_DATA_SNAPSHOT, RESULT_EXPECTED_TAX, RESULT_TOTAL_INCOME, RESULT_TOTAL_EXPENSE) SELECT #{userId}, TAX_INPUT_ID, #{scenario.name}, JSON_OBJECT('extraInc', #{scenario.extraInc}, 'extraExp', #{scenario.extraExp}, 'extraDonation', #{scenario.extraDonation}), #{scenario.totalTax}, #{scenario.totalIncome}, #{scenario.totalExpense} FROM tax_inputs WHERE TAX_INPUT_ID = #{scenario.taxInputId} AND (USER_ID IS NULL OR USER_ID = #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT SIMULATION_ID AS simulationId, TAX_INPUT_ID AS taxInputId, TITLE AS name, CAST(INPUT_DATA_SNAPSHOT->>'$.extraInc' AS DECIMAL(15,2)) AS extraInc, CAST(INPUT_DATA_SNAPSHOT->>'$.extraExp' AS DECIMAL(15,2)) AS extraExp, CAST(INPUT_DATA_SNAPSHOT->>'$.extraDonation' AS DECIMAL(15,2)) AS extraDonation, RESULT_EXPECTED_TAX AS totalTax, RESULT_TOTAL_INCOME AS totalIncome, RESULT_TOTAL_EXPENSE AS totalExpense FROM SIMULATION WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND TAX_INPUT_ID = #{taxInputId} ORDER BY SIMULATION_ID
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM SIMULATION WHERE SIMULATION_ID = #{simulationId} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tax_results (TAX_INPUT_ID, RESULT_DETAIL, CALCULATED_AT) VALUES (#{taxInputId}, #{resultDetail}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE RESULT_DETAIL = #{resultDetail}, CALCULATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT r.RESULT_DETAIL FROM tax_results r JOIN tax_inputs i ON i.TAX_INPUT_ID = r.TAX_INPUT_ID WHERE r.TAX_INPUT_ID = #{taxInputId} AND i.USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT TAX_YEAR AS taxYear, BUSINESS_REGISTERED AS businessRegistered, DEPENDENT_COUNT AS dependentCount, SPECIAL_DONATION_AMOUNT AS specialDonationAmount, GENERAL_DONATION_AMOUNT AS generalDonationAmount FROM tax_inputs WHERE TAX_INPUT_ID = #{taxInputId} AND (USER_ID = #{userId} OR USER_ID IS NULL)
SELECT MIN(TRANSACTION_DATE) AS firstDate, MAX(TRANSACTION_DATE) AS lastDate FROM tax_transactions WHERE TAX_INPUT_ID = #{taxInputId}

SELECT MONTH(TRANSACTION_DATE) AS month, TRANSACTION_TYPE AS transactionType, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'INCOME' THEN PRE_TAX_INCOME ELSE AMOUNT END ), 0), 0) AS amount, CASE WHEN TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'INCOME' AND COUNT(AMOUNT) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(AMOUNT) ELSE NULL END AS netIncome FROM tax_transactions WHERE TAX_INPUT_ID = #{taxInputId} AND TRANSACTION_TYPE IN ('INCOME', 'EXPENSE') GROUP BY MONTH(TRANSACTION_DATE), TRANSACTION_TYPE ORDER BY MONTH(TRANSACTION_DATE), TRANSACTION_TYPE

SELECT TRANSACTION_TYPE AS transactionType, CATEGORY AS category, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'INCOME' THEN PRE_TAX_INCOME ELSE AMOUNT END), 0) AS amount FROM tax_transactions WHERE TAX_INPUT_ID = #{taxInputId} AND TRANSACTION_TYPE IN ('INCOME', 'EXPENSE') GROUP BY TRANSACTION_TYPE, CATEGORY ORDER BY TRANSACTION_TYPE, amount DESC, category
